name: Can cable railing be installed on existing decks or staircases?

mainEntity.name: Can cable railing be installed on existing decks or staircases?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, cable railing can often be installed on existing decks or staircases, provided the current structure is sound and can adequately support the new railing system. A crucial step is to assess the condition of your existing posts or framing to determine if they are robust enough or if modifications are needed. In areas like Livermore or Pleasanton, Hometelligent Inc. conducts a thorough structural evaluation as part of our initial consultation to ensure compatibility and identify any necessary upgrades. This assessment is vital for a safe and durable installation.
